Definition: to pounce as a bird of prey
BiblicalUsage: ṭûws stands behind the English phrase to swoop, to pounce as a bird of prey. In Job 9:26, as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ṭûws still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
